pricing.basis: Standard synchronous API token estimate from provider usage, not invoice measurement

fusion_policy: Union of actual B40 and C40, deduplicate exact canonical source spans, sum reciprocal ranks at constant60, retain40. Ties: minimum backend rank then canonical span tuple. Measure full union coverage separately.
context_policy: Group all40 ranked hits by node, retaining every exact source span, role and date. Preserve original question/date. Reject oversize prompts without truncation. No labels or original session identifiers enter model requests.
baseline_policy: First three distinct owners from the same final passage pool. Verify B/C against saved application selections.
execution_order: Rotate three pool orders by case index and repetition. Three independent identical-prompt requests at temperature0. No best-of selection.
claims: Selection-only replay over frozen actual retrieval. Reused exposed development questions, not independent holdout or full answer evaluation. Hybrid uses two searches even though its final passage/context cap is matched. No fresh GPU, live hybrid latency, or retriever superiority claim.
